candidates.summary: a realm path taken from a fork-controlled directory name is written into comment.md unescaped, and the privileged publish job posts that file verbatim as the bot's comment
candidates.failure_scenario: A fork pull request adds examples/gno.land/r/x/ev`il/ with a valid gnomod.toml module line (plan.go:137 derives Path from the directory, not from the module line, so gnodev still loads the package). BuildPlan puts gno.land/r/x/ev`il in plan.Realms; Comment() wraps every realm in a markdown code span (comment.go:33) with no escaping, so the backtick closes the span and comment.md carries `- [`gno.land/r/x/ev`il`](...)`. render() writes that file at main.go:156 and pr-preview-publish.yml:174-177 posts it with `gh api -F body=@_preview/comment.md` as github-actions[bot] on gnolang/gno, on every push, before any human review. No successful crawl of the hostile realm is needed: Comment() lists plan.Realms and never consults the crawler. Index() (main.go:141) has the same hole into the published index.html, where GitHub's comment sanitizer does not apply.
candidates.verify_by: cp reviews/pr/6xxx/6194-gnoweb-pr-preview/1-ecf7af0/tests/b3-catalog-r2-comment-injection.go misc/gnopreview/zz_inject_test.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run 'TestCommentEscapesRealmPath|TestIndexEscapesRealmPath' ./...
candidates.evidence:
Both tests FAIL at ecf7af0. comment.md: `- [`gno.land/r/x/ev`il`](https://gnolang.github.io/gno-previews/pr-1/r/x/ev`il/) · [source](...)`. index.html: `
  • gno.land/r/x/ev`il`.

candidates.summary: gnodev's key directory and both gnodev logs are created inside -out, the directory the tool hands its caller to publish
candidates.failure_scenario: startGnodev sets -home to filepath.Join(cfg.out, ".gnodev-<port>") and os.Create's gnodev.log / gnodev-base.log in the same directory, so the snapshot the README tells a caller to serve contains the node's home and the build logs. pr-preview.yml:103 only works because it remembers `rm -rf _preview/gnodev.log _preview/gnodev-base.log _preview/.gnodev-*`; anyone running `gnopreview render -out _preview` by hand and serving _preview publishes them. The scratch state belongs outside -out (os.MkdirTemp, or a sibling directory), so no caller has to know the deny list.
candidates.verify_by: grep -n 'rm -rf _preview' .github/workflows/pr-preview.yml — the workflow carries the cleanup the tool should not need

candidates.summary: render never clears a pre-existing -out, so a second run publishes the first run's pages beside the new ones
candidates.failure_scenario: render() only os.MkdirAll's cfg.out. Running it twice in one tree (the documented local flow in misc/gnopreview/README.md) leaves every page, screenshot and _before/ capture the earlier plan produced, while preview.json and index.html list only the new plan's realms: the published snapshot then serves stale realm pages nothing links to, and a realm dropped from the plan still resolves. CI never sees it because each job gets a fresh runner.
candidates.verify_by: run `gnopreview render -changed a.txt -out _preview` then again with a disjoint changed list, and diff `ls -R _preview` against the second preview.json
